args.body: Take CATALOGUE-CASE-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL under a valid lease. Reuse an equivalent committed rehearsal if one exists. Otherwise use the fictional request and docs/AGENTMAIL.md to extract the two CSV excerpts and approval brief, run the existing checker with the documented case inputs and runtime where feasible, and produce one copy-ready EN/FR inline reply. Tie A-01, B-02 and C-03 to actual findings, and verify that explicit approval changes B-02 from correct to keep while the findings stay fixed. Measure UTF-8 bytes and reply characters. If the checker cannot fit the case contract, document the precise dependency and demonstrate the smallest manual workflow that preserves the B-02 decision. Save and read back the outputs before closing with a lesson. Use no private correspondence or live send. An authorized case must establish actual source inclusion, execution and delivery. The candidate digest b5192231bdfa03f011ea45273891c67b883b7c0a4f4d2bef75f7b22e684aa711 remains subject to independent review before publication.
